## Outcome

Describe the user-facing or repository-facing result.

## Verification

List the focused commands and evidence used while implementing the change.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] This PR was opened as a draft after the first coherent implementation commit.
- [ ] The change is one bounded feature or cleanup task.
- [ ] Focused tests passed during implementation.
- [ ] `npm run verify:fast` passes locally.
- [ ] The PR is marked ready only after its implementation and focused verification are complete.
- [ ] All required GitHub checks pass on the exact head commit before merge.
- [ ] The diff contains no private corpus material, credentials, local paths, databases, or private screenshots.

## Adversarial receipt

State the claim, the three most realistic failure modes, and the direct evidence that addresses them.
